symptom: `mxcli run --local` on a Mendix 11.14 app dies at `bundling web client: no rollup.config.mjs in …/deployment/web (run a serve Deploy build first)` — and a serve Deploy build HAS just run
cause: 11.14 bundles the browser client itself. `BuildWebClient` exists to close a gap that 11.13 and earlier left (client source + a rollup config, but no bundler run), and its gate tested for the CONFIG, so it failed on the absence of a file whose purpose had been served. Measured on a blank app, same build target: 11.13 `rollup.config.mjs` PRESENT / `dist/index.js` ABSENT; 11.14 exactly inverted
insight: **Gate a compatibility step on the GAP it closes, not on the shape one version happened to leave behind.** Skip when `WebClientBundled(deployDir)` is already true; keep requiring the config when it is not, because then rollup is the only thing that can produce a bundle. Do NOT make it an unconditional no-op when `dist/` exists — `runlocal.go:1091` re-bundles when the file is present but not SERVED, and a blanket skip would break that recovery. The doc comment called it "no-op-safe" and it was not; it is now. Affects EVERY 11.14 app, so a version-gated workaround is wrong — the condition is about the bundle, not the version. ako/mxcli-ledger #146
